cards.headline: Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong sentenced to 10 years
cards.summary: Wong, 30, was sentenced to 10 years in prison for his second conviction under Beijing's national security law. He has been jailed since 2020. Critics say the case reflects the crackdown on Hong Kong's pro-democracy movement.
cards.why_it_matters: The sentence shows how far Hong Kong's freedoms have narrowed under Beijing's security law, a factor in US-China relations and for Americans doing business in the city.

sources.title: Joshua Wong, face of Hong Kong's pro-democracy protests, jailed for 10 years
Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong sentenced to 10 years in prison

cards.headline: Nintendo Switch 2 sales plunge 41% after price hikes
cards.summary: Switch 2 sales fell 41% in Nintendo's fiscal second quarter after the company raised prices amid soaring memory chip costs.
cards.why_it_matters: Memory shortages are pushing up prices on consumer electronics, including game consoles, and are starting to dent demand.

sources.title: Nintendo Switch 2 sales plunge 41% as price hikes and memory crunch bite

cards.headline: Commerzbank profit jumps 45% ahead of UniCredit takeover
cards.summary: Commerzbank reported a 45% rise in profit, better than expected, in one of its last quarters before UniCredit takes control. It cut its lending income outlook, citing competition for deposits. The CEO said the bank acts from strength.
cards.why_it_matters: The takeover is a major test of cross-border bank consolidation in Europe, a key market for US banks and investors.

sources.title: Commerzbank Flags Deposit Competition Before UniCredit Deal
Commerzbank in 'Position of Strength' Ahead of UniCredit Deal, CEO Says

cards.headline: Emirates profit falls 66% as Iran war and oil costs bite
cards.summary: Emirates Group's first-half profit fell by more than half as regional warfare and high oil prices weighed on the world's largest international carrier, Bloomberg reports.
cards.why_it_matters: It shows the Iran war's cost to global aviation and the fuel and travel prices Americans may face.

sources.title: Emirates Profit Drops 66% as Iran War, High Oil Prices Hit Dubai Airline

cards.headline: NextDC soars 51% as Goodman and Digital Realty seek stakes
cards.summary: NextDC shares jumped nearly 51% after Goodman Group and Digital Realty sought to acquire up to a 9.9% stake. The Australian data center operator fell about 40% in October after cutting its forecast.
cards.why_it_matters: Dealmaking for data center assets continues even as US voters and investors question the AI buildout.

sources.title: NextDC shares soar nearly 51% after Goodman, Digital Realty stake purchases

cards.headline: Asian tech stocks slide, Hong Kong rebounds in post-midterm rotation
cards.summary: Asian chip and tech stocks fell on concerns that Democratic control of Congress will slow data center building, while Hong Kong shares rose as investors rotated into discounted Chinese internet platforms, the FT and Bloomberg report.
cards.why_it_matters: The shift shows how US politics is moving global AI-linked stocks, which affect many Americans' retirement accounts.

sources.title: Asian tech stocks slide on post-midterm AI fears
Hong Kong Stocks Roar Back as Value Rotation Boosts China Tech

cards.headline: Orsted completes US wind farm Trump tried to stop
cards.summary: Orsted finished building an offshore wind farm off the northeast US coast that became a focus of the Trump administration's efforts to curb the nascent American offshore wind industry.
cards.why_it_matters: It tests whether federal opposition can stop projects that add to the Northeast's electricity supply amid rising power costs.

sources.title: Orsted Completes Offshore Wind Farm That Trump Tried to Stop

cards.headline: German politician Hubert Aiwanger found dead in Berlin hotel
cards.summary: Hubert Aiwanger, 55, deputy leader of Bavaria's state government, was found dead in a Berlin hotel on Wednesday. Police and prosecutors have opened an investigation; the cause of death has not been given.
cards.why_it_matters: Aiwanger was a prominent figure in German politics; the circumstances are unconfirmed pending the investigation.

sources.title: Hubert Aiwanger, prominent German politician, found dead in Berlin hotel

cards.headline: Paraguay shuts Ueno Bank, sparking nationwide protests
cards.summary: Protests broke out across Paraguay after authorities shut Ueno Bank overnight over a solvency crisis. Al Jazeera reports the bank held savings of about half the population.
cards.why_it_matters: A bank failure on this scale can shake a region's financial confidence and affects Americans with business or family ties there.

sources.title: Paraguay bank collapses with half of population’s savings

cards.headline: Indonesia deploys troops in Jakarta amid wiretapping scandal
cards.summary: Indonesia's military is mobilizing troops to bolster security in Jakarta as authorities investigate the alleged wiretapping of President Prabowo Subianto, Bloomberg reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Instability in Southeast Asia's largest economy matters for regional security and for US companies and partners there.

sources.title: Indonesia Deploys Troops Amid Wiretapping Scandal

cards.headline: Philippine inflation hits 7.8%, near four-year high
cards.summary: Philippine inflation accelerated to 7.8% in October, close to the fastest pace in almost four years, as the prolonged Middle East conflict raised energy costs. That raises the odds of another large rate increase.
cards.why_it_matters: It shows how the Iran war's energy shock is feeding inflation abroad, a pressure also felt in US prices.

sources.title: Philippine October Inflation Accelerates 7.8%, Close to Four-Year High

cards.headline: South Korea to widen naval patrols toward Strait of Hormuz
cards.summary: Seoul will seek parliamentary approval to extend its Cheonghae anti-piracy unit's area to about 650km from Hormuz, after criticism from Donald Trump over South Korea's support for the Iran war.
cards.why_it_matters: US allies are being pressed to contribute to Gulf security, which affects shipping and oil prices.

sources.title: South Korea says it will expand naval operations closer to strait of Hormuz

cards.headline: After midterm loss, Trump faces hard choices on Iran
cards.summary: Axios reports Trump, who has said the Iran war cost Republicans dearly, must choose between a deal and returning to bombing, and that every option carries problems. Bloomberg reports Hormuz diplomacy is gaining ground.
cards.why_it_matters: The decision affects US troops, oil and gasoline prices, and whether a Democratic Congress will try to constrain the war.

sources.title: After midterm defeat, Trump faces mostly bad options in Iran
Hormuz Diplomacy Gains Ground as Trump Plays Down New Iran Strikes

cards.headline: Syria and Saudi Arabia sign defence deal and $403 million loans
cards.summary: Syria and Saudi Arabia signed a defence cooperation deal and agreed $403 million in loans as President al-Sharaa visited Riyadh for the second time in under a month.
cards.why_it_matters: Gulf backing for Syria's government reshapes regional alliances that US policy depends on.

sources.title: Syria, Saudi Arabia sign defence cooperation deal, agree $403m in loans

cards.headline: Herzog accepts Israeli vote result and opens coalition talks
cards.summary: President Isaac Herzog accepted the election results and opened talks on forming a government, a blow to Netanyahu's claims the vote was stolen. Netanyahu's rivals say the US midterm results show Israel cannot afford to keep him.
cards.why_it_matters: Israel's next government will shape the Gaza ceasefire, Iran policy and US-Israel ties as Democrats take Congress.

sources.title: Israel’s Herzog accepts vote results, opens talks on forming a government
Israel’s opposition slams ‘toxic Netanyahu’ after Democrats win US Congress

cards.headline: Zelenskyy speaks with Witkoff and Kushner before trilateral talks
cards.summary: Zelenskyy said he spoke for 90 minutes with US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner ahead of talks with the US and Russia. He and EU officials hope a Democratic Congress will bring more US help and pressure on Russia.
cards.why_it_matters: The talks and US congressional politics will influence US aid to Ukraine and prospects for ending the war.

sources.title: Zelensky speaks with US envoys ahead of trilateral talks
Zelenskyy hopes Democratic Congress will bring more US help for Ukraine

cards.headline: Democratic Congress expected to try to constrain Trump abroad
cards.summary: The Guardian and Al Jazeera say Democrats may try to limit Trump on Iran, tariffs and Ukraine aid, but he keeps veto power and can still set policy on those issues.
cards.why_it_matters: Divided government will shape US war powers, trade policy and prices over the next two years.

sources.title: A Democratic-controlled Congress will likely try to constrain Trump’s foreign adventures
Democrats won Congress. But can they deliver on their promises?

cards.headline: Massie gives Hegseth resign-or-impeachment ultimatum
cards.summary: Rep. Thomas Massie, R-Ky., said War Secretary Pete Hegseth can resign or face impeachment articles in the final stretch of this Congress. Republicans have also blamed the Iran war for midterm losses.
cards.why_it_matters: An impeachment push against the Pentagon chief would add to the fight over the Iran war and the defense budget.

sources.title: Massie gives Hegseth impeachment ultimatum as GOP pins blue wave on Iran war

cards.headline: Wiener wins Pelosi's seat; Raman ousts Bass in Los Angeles
cards.summary: Scott Wiener is poised to win Nancy Pelosi's San Francisco House seat after Connie Chan conceded. In Los Angeles, Nithya Raman is projected to unseat Mayor Karen Bass by about 3 points, per Decision Desk HQ.
cards.why_it_matters: Two of California's biggest Democratic offices change hands, signaling new directions in the party's leadership.

sources.title: Scott Wiener prevails in race to succeed retiring Pelosi
Raman ousts Bass as Los Angeles mayor

cards.headline: Cruz says GOP missed cost of living as Democrats sweep Texas
cards.summary: Sen. Ted Cruz, R-Texas, said Republicans did not understand voters' cost-of-living concerns and called Democratic wins a blue tsunami, with Talarico beating Paxton and Hinojosa unseating Abbott. He warned Texans will be hurt by the result.
cards.why_it_matters: Texas, long Republican, now has a Democratic senator and governor-elect, reshaping both parties' 2028 calculations.

sources.title: Ted Cruz says 'blue tsunami' took over Texas after Democrats swept statewide races
Cruz suggests GOP ignored cost of living as top midterm issue: ‘They didn’t understand’

cards.headline: Election deniers lose governor races in key swing states
cards.summary: Candidates who had questioned past election results lost governor races in key swing states. Al Jazeera notes governors hold sway over election administration ahead of the 2028 presidential race.
cards.why_it_matters: State leaders oversee how elections run, so these results affect the 2028 vote.

sources.title: Election deniers lose races for governor in key US swing states

cards.headline: California billionaire tax set to fail despite Democratic wave
cards.summary: The FT reports California's Proposition 40 billionaire tax is set to be defeated, a rare win for mega-donors, though the Democratic wave keeps US wealth tax proposals alive elsewhere.
cards.why_it_matters: Wealth taxes could become part of the national tax debate under a Democratic Congress.

sources.title: Democratic wave keeps US wealth taxes alive despite California loss

cards.headline: New Zealand heads into knife-edge election
cards.summary: Al Jazeera reports smaller parties hold the key in New Zealand's election, with major contenders expected to fall short of the majority needed to govern alone.
cards.why_it_matters: A close result in a US ally could shift New Zealand's stance on trade and security in the Pacific.

sources.title: New Zealand braces for knife-edge election: What you need to know

cards.headline: France braces for nationwide strike and marches over costs
cards.summary: Hundreds of thousands are expected to march as unions call a strike that may include hospital, air traffic and rail workers. It extends more than a month of protests while parliamentary budget talks remain deadlocked.
cards.why_it_matters: Prolonged unrest in a major US ally and euro zone economy affects travel, markets and European stability.

sources.title: Protesters to join nationwide march as France braces for day of strike action
France Braces for Marches and Strikes Amid Stalled Budget

cards.headline: Pound hits highest level since the Brexit referendum
cards.summary: The pound reached its highest level against a basket of currencies since the Brexit referendum a decade ago, the BBC reports, ahead of a Bank of England decision expected to raise rates.
cards.why_it_matters: A stronger pound and rising UK rates affect currency markets and the cost of travel and trade for Americans.

sources.title: Pound rises to its highest level since the Brexit referendum

cards.headline: Poundland owner in crunch talks as collapse looms
cards.summary: Gordon Brothers, owner of Poundland, was due to meet UK business secretary Jonathan Reynolds as the discount retailer's collapse looms, the BBC reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Retail failures show pressure on household budgets amid the cost-of-living crisis in the UK and Europe.

sources.title: Poundland owner in crunch talks as retailer's collapse looms

cards.headline: China copper squeeze deepens as buyers scramble for metal
cards.summary: Copper buyers in China are scrambling for physical metal, with spot premiums soaring as supplies tighten sharply in the world's biggest consumer.
cards.why_it_matters: Tight copper supply can raise costs for wiring, power grids and data centers, and for US manufacturers.

sources.title: China’s Copper Squeeze Deepens as Buyers Scramble

cards.headline: ArcelorMittal expects boost from tougher EU steel curbs
cards.summary: ArcelorMittal's third-quarter earnings came in just above expectations, giving investors an early read on how EU trade curbs have affected Europe's biggest steelmaker.
cards.why_it_matters: Tighter EU steel protections can reshape global steel trade, including US exports and prices.

sources.title: ArcelorMittal Sees Profit Boost From Tougher EU Steel Curbs

cards.headline: UK 'dangerously' reliant on China for critical minerals, MPs say
cards.summary: A parliamentary investigation found the UK dangerously dependent on China for raw materials used in defence, renewable energy and AI. MPs call for centralised policy and funding for mines and diversification.
cards.why_it_matters: The same dependence affects the US and its allies, shaping supply-chain and defense planning.

sources.title: UK found to be ‘dangerously’ reliant on China for critical minerals needed for defence and AI

cards.headline: Apple reportedly cuts budgets for internal AI use
cards.summary: Apple is reportedly significantly reducing what it spends on AI tools for its engineering teams, TechCrunch reports, citing reports without further detail.
cards.why_it_matters: It suggests even the largest tech companies are weighing the cost of AI as investors question spending.

sources.title: Apple is reportedly cutting budgets for its internal AI usage

cards.headline: Figma falls despite earnings beat as AI costs weigh
cards.summary: Figma shares fell after earnings as it lets customers use more AI features for the same price, a move meant to boost long-term growth. MarketWatch says investors worry about the high cost of delivering AI.
cards.why_it_matters: It shows the margin pressure software firms face as AI features become costly to run.

sources.title: Figma sinks after earnings beat as company prioritizes long-term growth with AI changes
Figma’s stock dips as investors worry that AI momentum is coming at a high price

cards.headline: Chipmakers battle over talent and trade secrets as China gains
cards.summary: CNBC reports growing competition for semiconductor talent is fueling disputes over trade secrets as Chinese chipmakers gain ground against South Korean and other rivals.
cards.why_it_matters: The fight for engineers shapes who leads in chips, central to US technology and security.

sources.title: Inside the chip talent war: Trade secrets and rising Chinese rivals

cards.headline: Tech investors turn to space data centers after ballot losses
cards.summary: After Democrats won in Texas and other AI infrastructure hot spots, data center enthusiasts looked to low Earth orbit for alternatives, Wired reports. TechCrunch says a bigger clash over data centers may follow the midterms.
cards.why_it_matters: Local opposition to data centers is pushing the AI industry to look for other places to put computing power.

sources.title: The Blue Wave Has Tech Bros Scrambling for Data Centers in Space
After the midterms, a bigger clash over data centers could be coming

cards.headline: NASA unveils X-70 Fractal experimental aircraft
cards.summary: NASA unveiled the X-70 Fractal at Kennedy Space Center, describing it as a high-performance, adaptable research platform meant to speed development and testing of advanced aviation technologies.
cards.why_it_matters: New X-planes feed technology that can reach commercial and military aviation.

sources.title: NASA Announces X-70 Experimental Aircraft to Advance Flight Research

cards.headline: Warming UK seas could reshape marine ecosystems by 2050
cards.summary: A four-year study warns warming seas around the UK and north-east Atlantic could destabilise marine food webs and weaken ocean health, putting food security at risk by 2050.
cards.why_it_matters: Changes in North Atlantic fisheries and ecosystems can affect seafood supply and prices well beyond Britain.

sources.title: Warming UK seas could ‘fundamentally reshape marine ecosystems’ – report

cards.headline: Researchers say Iron Age ruler Verica was probably a woman
cards.summary: An archaeologist argues that Verica, the British ruler who encouraged Emperor Claudius to invade in AD 43, was probably a woman rather than the man historians assumed. The theory is described as controversial.
cards.why_it_matters: It could change how the origins of Roman Britain are told.

sources.title: British Iron Age ‘king’ who prompted Roman invasion was probably a woman
Historians say King Verica persuaded Rome to invade Britain. But could Verica actually have been a queen?

cards.headline: UK law banning some sexual content draws censorship fears
cards.summary: Adult content creators and free speech advocates warn about a UK law taking effect that bans simulated incest and some depictions of oral sex, Wired reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Online content rules abroad can affect US platforms and creators serving UK users.

sources.title: A New UK Porn Ban Sparks Fears of Unprecedented Sex Censorship

cards.headline: Salvadoran troops deploy to Haiti as technicians go missing
cards.summary: El Salvador's Bukele touted military intervention in Haiti as Salvadoran troops deploy. Haitian police found a vehicle used by four missing Salvadoran technicians.
cards.why_it_matters: Haiti's gang crisis and foreign deployments affect migration and security in the Caribbean near the US.

sources.title: El Salvador’s Bukele touts military intervention in Haiti

cards.headline: Leon Black sues Rep. Robert Garcia over Epstein remarks
cards.summary: Billionaire Leon Black filed a defamation suit against Rep. Robert Garcia, D-Calif., alleging his statements about Black's relationship with Jeffrey Epstein were defamatory. Garcia's response was not in the report.
cards.why_it_matters: The suit tests how far a member of Congress can go in public statements about Epstein-linked figures.

sources.title: Billionaire Leon Black hits Rep. Robert Garcia with defamation suit over Epstein remarks

cards.headline: Trump urges Congress to pass permanent daylight saving time
cards.summary: President Trump called on the Senate to pass the Sunshine Protection Act, which would make daylight saving time permanent, after what he called a ridiculous early sunset. The bill has passed the House.
cards.why_it_matters: It would end twice-yearly clock changes for Americans if enacted.

sources.title: Trump urges Congress to pass daylight saving bill after 'ridiculous' early sunset
Trump pressures Senate on Sunshine Protection Act over ‘ridiculous’ early sunsets

cards.headline: Bob Dylan visits Pope Leo at Vatican
cards.summary: Bob Dylan met Pope Leo at the pope's residence between concert dates in Italy. The Vatican said the encounter was brief. Leo had quoted Dylan in a preface to a book warning against nuclear rearmament.
cards.why_it_matters: A light moment linking the American pope with one of America's best-known songwriters.

sources.title: Bob Dylan comes knockin' on pope's door as Leo welcomes legend to Vatican
Pope Leo hosts Bob Dylan at official residence in Rome

cards.headline: Record 53 red cards shown in Brazil under-20 match
cards.summary: A mass brawl in a match between Uberlandia and Mamore produced 43 red cards for players, eight for coaching staff and two for board members, a Guinness World Record.
cards.why_it_matters: A rare sports oddity with no wider consequence beyond discipline for the clubs.

sources.title: Guinness World Record broken as 53 red cards shown in Brazil under-20 match
